sections.section: RULE - Islamabad Capital Territory Drugs Rules 1989
sections.description:
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY DRUGS RULES, 1989
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL
TERRITORY DRUGS RULES, 1989
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 11, 30th December, 1989]
S.R.O. 1241(1)/89, dated 21‑12‑1989.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 44 of the Drugs
Act, 1970 (XXXI of 1976), read with the Justice Division's Notification
No.17(2)/80‑Pub, dated the 31st December, 1980, issued in
pursuance of Article 2 of the Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration)
Order, 1980 (P.O.No.18 of 1980), and all other powers enabling him in this
behalf, the Administrator, Islamabad Capital Territory, is pleased to make the
following Rules, namely:‑‑
PART I ‑‑
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) These Rules may
he called the Islamabad Capital Territory Drugs Rules, 1989.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2 . Definition.‑‑In
these rules, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑‑
(a) "Act" means the
Drugs Act, 1976 (XXXI of 1976).
(b) "Board" means the
Islamabad Capital Territory Quality Control Board.
(c) " Form " means form prescribed in Schedule " A
"
(d) "Government" means the Administrator, Islamabad
Capital Territory.
(e) " Narcotic and other controlled drugs " means the
drug specified in Schedule " B
".
(f) " Pharmacy " means a shop, Store or place where
drugs are compounded or prepared on prescription, it shall include a place
which bears the words, pharmacy, Pharmacist or dispensing chemist and shall
conform to requirement laid down in schedule " F ".
(g) " Registered medical practitioner " means a medical
practitioner regis tered under the Pakistan medical and dental council
Ordinance, 162 (XXXII of 1962),
(h) "Schedule means a schedule to these rules.
(i) " Section " means section of the Act.
(j) "Whole sales" sale by way of whole sale dealing means
sale to a person who buys for the purpose
of selling again.
PART II, ‑ISLAMABAD
CAPITAL TERRITORY (ICT) QUALITY CONTROL BOARD. GOVERNMENT ANALYST AND ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY DRUG
INSPECTOR.
3. Islamabad Capital Territory Quality Control Board.‑( The
Board shall consist of the following members. namely:‑
(a) The Administrator, Islamabad Capital Territory, Islamabad who
shall be is en‑officio Chairman.
(b) Deputy Commissioner-Director Health Services, Islamabad Capital Territory, Islamabad.
(c) Chairman, Quality Control Authority,. Ministry of Health,
Islamabad
(d) District Health Officer. Islamabad Capital Territory, Islamabad.
(e) One Pharmacologist preferable Professor of Pharmacology to be
nominated by the Administrator, ICT, having no financial interest in
Pharmaceutical Trade and Industry.
(f) One Professor of Medicine to be nominated by the Administrator,
ICT, having no financial interest in Pharmaceutical Trade and Industry.
(g) Inspector of Drugs, Islamabad Capital Territory, ex‑Officio Secretary.
(2) The Board may co‑opt
any other qualified expert having formal training and experience in the
Pharmaceutical field.
(3) The quorum to constitute a
meeting of the Board shall be three including its Chairman.
(4) No act or proceeding of the
Board shall be invalid merely on the ground of the existence of any vacancy in
or any defect in the constitution of the Board,
4. Function of the Board,‑The
Inspector and the Government Analyst shall submit monthly returns in Form‑1.
and Form‑2 respectively, to the Board
and summary on the overall situation of quality control in the area under
their respective jurisdiction and the Board shall maintain such information so
as to monitor the quality of all the drugs sold and to kept watch on the
performance of all manufactures and the drugs sale licence holders.
(2) The Board shall as far as
possible meet at least once in a month and review the situation of the quality
control of drugs on whole including considera tion of any specific point
arising during the period on the working of various firms, Drug Testing
Laboratories and Inspectors.
